limitations: No local runtime is currently available.

The 22 protocol/process tests, fresh seven-module Lean source fixture, and both all-owned audit partitions passed in run 44516414765. Its first kernel measurement was rejected after observing five OS threads with a four-thread limit.

This revision disables the identified libuv io_uring kernel helper using the pinned library's supported environment switch. It preserves the same three-runtime-thread overhead and requires fresh hosted validation at 1, 2, 3, and 4 requested workers.
The wrappers are opt-in candidates and do not replace the accepted gate.

audit_partition_repair.reason: Modern import-all auditing and legacy-root auditing require separate Lean module modes; ownership is partitioned exactly and endpoint sets are recombined without duplicates.
audit_partition_repair.layout_root: Retain the configured fixture-only ProofAudit.lean root importing both project roots, while separately executing and freezing modern and legacy all-owned audits.
audit_partition_repair.explicit_command_import: Import Lean.Elab.Command in both audit modes so the minimal core-only fixture does not depend on Mathlib re-exporting run_cmd.

runtime_thread_accounting.guard: requested ordinary task workers + three runtime threads (OS launcher, Lean main, libuv event loop); reject any additional threads or any child process
runtime_thread_accounting.reason: Generated C main calls lean_run_main. The runtime starts the Lean main function on a separate stack-managed thread and joins it from the OS launcher. Runtime initialization also starts a persistent libuv event-loop thread before Lean main. The checker schedules default-priority replay tasks, and waits for them from the Lean main thread. The total sampled guard remains strict and rejects any extra compensating worker threads.

observed_prior_failure.interpretation: Runtime source inspection identifies the uncounted persistent libuv event-loop thread; no kernel pass is claimed for this failed run.

runtime_thread_accounting.sysroot_binding: Use the validated source receipt's compiler prefix (or the pinned checker's adjacent compiler for a standalone kernel phase); require the same pinned checker in that distribution and Init.olean. Record and recheck both compiler and checker hashes. Keep the three-runtime-thread overhead and all process/RSS limits unchanged.

observed_latest_failure.reason: The OS thread inventory identifies a kernel io_uring SQPOLL helper, in addition to the three userspace runtime threads and one proof worker. The pinned release uses libuv 1.48.0, whose UV_USE_IO_URING=0 switch disables this helper without changing the checker or increasing its thread guard.
